description:
SBrowserX v1.3.5 — Seamless System-Bar Blur, Start Page Polish & Deep Performance Cleanup:
• Seamless Monolithic Bottom & Nav Bar Blur: In Standard/Focus layouts, the live frosted-glass blur now flows continuously from the address bar through the bottom toolbar all the way behind the system navigation buttons (≡ ○ ↩) with zero horizontal seam or dark strip.
• Live Status Bar Blur on Scroll: Restored real-time Chromium status bar blur when scrolling webpages in dark/light themes, while keeping Settings and URL editing clean.
• Zero-Flicker Start Page & Compact Mode: Eliminated black flashes on cold start and pull-to-refresh (cached RAM wallpaper, inlined initial CSS/state/weather, SO_REUSEADDR, hidden scrollbars, edge-to-edge wallpaper backdrop with auto status-bar icon contrast).
• Smarter Homepage & Quick Access Routing: SBrowserX Start Page is enabled by default with a native One UI card in Homepage settings; 'Add page to -> Quick access' now automatically saves shortcuts to whichever Start Page is active (SBrowserX Start Page with live tab refresh, or stock Samsung Quick Access).
• Faster Cold Start & Background Cleanup: Added WebRTC cold-start fast-path, orange indicator dot on active Restart button, and disabled residual Samsung background overhead (SmpJobService, GlobalConfigUpdateClient, SmartTabDelete ML training, DataLake top-sites telemetry, NewsFeed fetches, SIActivatedLoggingTask) plus silenced the annoying 'This page was opened by <App>' snackbar.

RU — SBrowserX v1.3.5 (Бесшовный блюр, доработка стартовой страницы и ускорение работы):
• Монолитный блюр нижней панели и кнопок навигации: в обычном/Focus макете живое матовое стекло теперь идёт единым слоем от адресной строки через панель кнопок до самого низа за системные кнопки (≡ ○ ↩) — без швов и чёрных полос.
• Живой блюр статус-бара при прокрутке: возвращено нативное размытие статус-бара при скролле сайтов (привязано к настройкам размытия и прозрачности нижней панели).
• Стартовая страница без мерцаний: убраны чёрные вспышки при холодном старте и обновлении свайпом вниз (кэш обоев в RAM, встроенные стартовые стили и погода, скрытые скроллбары, автоконтраст иконок статус-бара, аккуратная подложка за навигацией в Компактном макете).
• Умное добавление в «Быстрый доступ»: пункт «Добавить страницу → Быстрый доступ» теперь сохраняет ярлык на активную стартовую страницу (SBrowserX с мгновенным обновлением открытой вкладки или стандартную Samsung); стартовая SBrowserX включена по умолчанию и оформлена нативной карточкой One UI в настройках «Домашняя страница».
• Ускорение запуска и чистка фона: ускорен холодный старт WebRTC, добавлена оранжевая точка на активной кнопке перезапуска, отключены лишние фоновые службы и запросы Samsung (SmpJobService, GlobalConfig, ML-обучение SmartTabDelete, DataLake, фоновые новости, пинг активации) и убрано навязчивое всплывающее уведомление «Эту страницу открыло приложение…».

patches.name: AMOLED Black & Bottom Bar Transparency
patches.description: Adds adjustable toolbar and bottom bar transparency with frosted-glass blur and pure AMOLED black mode for the browser interface.

patches.name: Auto-close unused tabs: After 1 day
patches.description: Adds an 'After 1 day' option to the Auto-close unused tabs setting.

patches.name: Block third-party cookies by default
patches.description: Blocks third-party cookies by default across all websites, with an option to re-enable them in Settings.

patches.name: Built-in Google Translate engine
patches.description: Adds a built-in page translation engine with automatic translation and quick language settings.

patches.name: Change package and app name
patches.description: Changes the package name, custom permissions, provider authorities, internal content:// URIs, UriMatcher rules, and app display name so SBrowserX runs cleanly alongside stock Samsung Internet.

options.description: Custom Android package name for the patched browser.
Custom launcher display name for the patched browser.

patches.name: Disable Update Prompts & Badges
patches.description: Hides store update prompts, banners, and update badges.

patches.name: External downloader support
patches.description: Sends file, image, video, and link downloads to your chosen external download manager.

patches.name: Remove 99-Tab Limit
patches.description: Removes the 99-tab limit so you can keep thousands of open tabs.

patches.name: Remove telemetry, promotions & updates
patches.description: Removes built-in analytics, promotional banners, shopping ads, and background update checks while keeping website notifications working.

patches.name: SBrowserX Settings, Extensions & Privacy Core
patches.description: Adds SBrowserX settings hub and mirrors all toggles natively in-place across Samsung Internet's settings sections.

patches.name: Third-Party Autofill Support
patches.description: Enables native Android Autofill (Bitwarden, Gboard inline suggestions), removes Samsung Pass prompts, and unlocks local credit cards without Knox.

patches.name: Unified Dark Mode & True AMOLED Websites
patches.description: Synchronizes website dark mode with the browser theme, removes dim overlays, and applies pure AMOLED black backgrounds when enabled.

patches.name: Unlock Chrome Web Store & Extensions
patches.description: Enables extension support, unlocks the Chrome Web Store, and allows installing and keeping third-party extensions.

patches.name: Unlock Compact Layout
patches.description: Unlocks the compact floating toolbar layout, smooths scrolling behavior, and lets you customize the extra toolbar button.

patches.name: Unlock Debug settings menu
patches.description: Reveals the hidden Debug settings menu inside browser Settings.
